title: DocAntipatternAudit
description: Workspace-wide audit for doctrine violations. Per user directive 2026-05-14: 'audit existing docs as well for antipatterns'. Authored at /evidence/audits/ — canonical durable home per P11 (NOT under .omc/).

P11_durables_in_omc.remediation: F-MIGRATE-DURABLES-OUT-OF-OMC (already in fixuptasks.jsonl). Atomic migration: specs → /specs/, registries → /registries/, evidence → /evidence/, templates → /templates/. Cross-references rewritten via lane validator.

P14_filename_versioning_violations.description: JSON specs missing the -v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH> suffix in filename. Cross-references resolve by path alone; without the version, schema drift is invisible.
P14_filename_versioning_violations.remediation: F-NAMING-CONVENTION-ENFORCE — rename to <concept>-v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>.json during the P11 migration cutover

P15_language_default_violations.grit_worktree_duplicates_excluded: scripts/* duplicated under .grit/worktrees/*; same files; not counted
P15_language_default_violations.remediation: F-LANE-RUST-DEFAULT-ENFORCE — emit a per-file ADR-or-FixupTask requirement. Existing scripts grandfathered with explicit Rust port FixupTask: F-PORT-SCRIPTS-TO-RUST (each script gets its own bounded port task).
tickets_named: F-PORT-PY-RENDER-SCRIPTS-TO-RUST (cluster: master-plan-ledger, m02-exit-checklist, product-index, master-plan-completion, stage0-prereqs)

P9_sprawl_candidates.description: Files where markdown and JSON cover the same concept; potential drift. The multispectrum pair was slimmed THIS session — others need audit.
candidates_needing_audit: docs/standards/clean-architecture.md ↔ ADR-0056 (12-layer enum) — clean-architecture.md may restate ADR-0056 BNF content
P9_sprawl_candidates.remediation: F-AUDIT-STANDARDS-SPRAWL — per-pair audit + slim to thin-pointer-gateway shape OR consolidate. Bounded follow-up.

P10_naming_inconsistency_inside_existing.description: Some existing artifacts use snake_case (oya_http_*), some kebab-case (oya-http-*), some mixed. ADR-0056 BNF v4.1 mandates kebab-case package names + snake_case lib names — fine. Filenames OUTSIDE crates also mix conventions in docs/.

summary.doctrine_compliance_overall: RED — significant migration required; existing artifacts grandfathered with bounded remediation tasks; new artifacts MUST comply going forward

decision_log.what_changed: audit emitted to /evidence/audits/ (canonical durable home per P11)
decision_log.why: User directive 2026-05-14: 'audit existing docs as well for antipatterns'. Authored at /evidence/audits/ NOT under /evidence/ per P11.
